findings.claim: Alphabet 管理層稱 AI 算力需求大於供給、預期供給限制持續；Pichai 稱每日都受容量限制，現在要 2027 算力極難
findings.source: Beri.net: Google Cloud 82% Growth Hides a Serious Supply Problem (summary of Alphabet Q2 2026 results)
findings.excerpt: We are capacity constrained on a daily basis.

findings.claim: Cloud 積壓訂單約 5,140 億美元（Q2），預計 24 個月內消化 50%，多數於 2027–2028 轉營收；2026 capex 指引上調至 1,950–2,050 億美元
findings.source: WebSearch summary of Alphabet Q2 2026 results (Beri.net / TechCrunch / Fierce Network)
findings.excerpt: Alphabet expects to work through 50% of the backlog over the next "24 months", so much of it converts to revenue in 2027 and 2028.

findings.claim: EMARKETER 預測美國媒體廣告 2026 年增 15.6%、2027 年僅增 9.4%，部分來自世足賽與期中選舉等週期因素；IAB 亦提醒 2027 放緩
findings.source: EMARKETER: IAB raises ad spending forecast for 2026, but marketers should brace for 2027 slowdown
findings.excerpt: IAB raised its 2026 US ad growth forecast to 12.3%, mainly on cyclical factors and a strong first half.

findings.source: IAB/PwC via WebSearch summary of EMARKETER/IAB coverage
